summary: Directly closes the two provenance/honesty holes Codex found. (1) forge roadmap fill can NEVER overwrite shipped history: it refuses any card whose status is not pending (active AND done refused) and only fills blank fields, so a card flipping to done mid-flight is refused on write. (2) forge project backfill NEVER auto-fabricates provenance: a zero GitHub match is reported unresolved and check_board_complete stays red for it; predates_outcome_contract is set ONLY via the human-confirmed mark-predates (with a recorded reason). No regression to the FORGE-BOARD-4 dogfood (its 10 stories matched uniquely, none used zero-match->predates).
